newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade fairly active in Kansas on Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00 higher. Inquiry good, demand moderate.
Sales confirmed on 32,100 slaughter steers and 27,500 slaughter heifers Wednesday.
For the week to date 72,600 head confirmed including 14,100 head or about 19 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Slaughter steers Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1325 lbs 72.00; pen Select with end Choice 71.00; couple pens Select and Choice 1300 lb Holsteins 62.00-64.00.
Slaughter heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1200 lbs 72.00, couple pens 1000-1050 lbs 71.00-71.50; few mixed Commercial to Choice 1200-1280 lb heifers and heiferettes 70.00-72.00.
week to date: 72600 last week: 67600 last year: 8100
